episode_narrative: Isolated severe thunderstorm near a stationary boundary produced a weak tornado across portions of northeast North Carolina.
event_narratives: Public sited a tornado and tree damage was reported off Winston Farm Road off of Route 45.

episode_narrative: A cluster of thunderstorms producing pockets of damaging wind gusts moved into the North Carolina Piedmont from Upstate South Carolina during the evening. Several areas of wind damage were reported along the I-77 corridor.
event_narratives: County comms reported a couple of trees blown down in the  Harrisburg area. || County comms reported a couple of trees and power lines blown down in the Rockwell area.

episode_narrative: Isolated severe storms developed ahead of a cold front during the late afternoon in a moist and unstable air mass. A more organized comma head and trailing line of storms moved into the area mid to late evening. Some of the storms produced wind damage across portions of the area.
event_narratives: Five trees were reported down on Lake Forest Drive north of Badin Lake. || Trees were reported down on power lines near Lake Lucas. || One tree was reported down near the intersection of Forest and White Oak Avenues.

episode_narrative: A weak wedge front extended through the Piedmont, with stratus lasting through the day in the northwest Piedmont. Convection formed along the wedge front, coincident with a weak surface low over the Upstate of South Carolina. This then congealed into a curved band of convection which tracked northeastward into southwestern and western central North Carolina. A few of these storms became severe and produced wind damage.
event_narratives: One tree was reported down on power lines near the intersection of Pleasant Grove Church Road and Dennis Road. || One tree was reported down on Grassy Island Road. || One tree was reported down in the 1800 block of Hicks Road. || One tree was reported down on Pine Street.

episode_narrative: A stationary front produced strong storms with  hail and strong winds.
event_narratives: The public reported three quarter inch hail fell for several minutes. || There was some minor roof damage to the Wilson Center. || Quarter size hail was reported. || Quarter size hail fell. || Several large trees were blown down.
